blurb: Four Arrows offers a ropes challenge course with high and low elements designed for team building, leadership development, and personal growth. Programs focus on cooperation, problem solving, communication, and trust building. The course is located at the Depot Campus near UConn and includes an Ellington Cottage retreat facility for workshops and trainings.
extraNote: Cancellation: 100% refund if 1 month prior, 50% refund if 2 weeks prior, no refund if less than 48 hours · Weather: courses run rain or shine except heavy rain, heavy snow, lightning, or unsafe conditions · Request must be submitted at least 2 weeks prior, preferably 1 month before program date · Deposit required to hold date; full payment due within 30 days post program for outside groups · Depot Campus, behind Ellington Cottage
